ordering.floating_point_accumulation: sort all keys first; accumulate float64 left-to-right
ordering.serialization: UTF-8, LF, JSON object keys lexicographically sorted, no insignificant trailing whitespace
ordering.candidate_enumeration: model rank M0..M5, then lexicographic tuple of parameter values in registry column order

seed.encoding: UTF-8 NFC fields joined by one byte 0x1f; decimal integers have no sign or leading zero
seed.conversion: SHA-256 digest bytes 0..7 interpreted unsigned little-endian uint64
seed.prng: PCG-XSL-RR-128/64 with 128-bit state; seed is uint64 expanded by SplitMix64 twice
seed.sampling: sorted outcomes; half-open cumulative intervals; one uint64 mapped to [0,1) by the high 53 bits divided by 2^53

M0.bos_eos: not applicable between IID TOKEN draws; corpus stops at requested TOKEN count
M0.unseen: all unseen TOKEN strings share P(UNK); no post-fit lexicon insertion
M0.generation: draw observed TOKEN types plus UNK; an UNK draw emits the literal reserved token <UNK>; a drawn observed TOKEN longer than 64 glyphs is NON_GENERATIVE

M1.estimator: for history h of length order-1, P(x|h)=(c(h,x)+alpha*P(x|suffix(h)))/(c(h)+alpha), recursively; depth 0 uses (c(x)+alpha)/(C+alpha*(A+1))
M1.bos_eos: prepend order-1 distinct BOS symbols; EOS is one predicted outcome and never a history glyph
M1.unseen: drop the oldest history glyph until a realized context; unseen glyph maps to UNK_GLYPH at depth 0
M1.generation: draw until EOS; if EOS absent by 64 glyphs, force EOS and flag GENERATION_TRUNCATED

M2.estimator: retain suffix contexts with count>=min_context_count; in a realized context h with T distinct continuations and total C, seen x has c(h,x)/(C+T), escape has T/(C+T); exclusion backoff removes symbols already seen at h; depth -1 is uniform over alphabet plus EOS and UNK_GLYPH
M2.pruning: discard contexts below min_context_count; retain all others through max_depth
M2.bos_eos: prepend max_depth BOS symbols; EOS is a continuation
M2.unseen: escape repeatedly to a suffix; depth -1 supplies nonzero mass
M2.generation: inverse-CDF at deepest retained suffix; escape recursively; stop at EOS or force EOS at 64 glyphs and flag

M3.initial: prefix-tree acceptor over DEVELOPMENT TOKENs; transition and EOS counts retained only for merge diagnostics
M3.merge: candidate unordered state pairs sorted by (shortest access string left,right); merge first pair whose Jensen-Shannon divergence between additive-0.5 next-symbol distributions is <=threshold; recursively merge same-label targets; reject if recursive closure merges accept/nonaccept states; repeat to fixed point or max_states
M3.acceptance: start at root, consume each glyph through the unique labeled edge, then require accepting state
M3.failure: if fixed point has more than max_states, TRAINING_FAILED
M3.generation: at each state choose uniformly among sorted outgoing glyph edges plus EOS when accepting; stop on EOS; at 64 glyphs force EOS if accepting else NON_GENERATIVE
M3.unseen_scoring: accepted TOKEN probability is product of uniform branch probabilities; rejected TOKEN gets probability 0 and status HELDOUT_DEGENERATE
M3.tie_break: shortest access string, then code-point order

M4.topology: exact M3 algorithm and parameters merge_js_threshold,max_states on the same DEVELOPMENT input
M4.estimator: on fixed topology, replay DEVELOPMENT paths; for each state and enabled outgoing glyph/EOS, P=(count+alpha)/(total+alpha*K); no EM and no topology pruning beyond M3
M4.failure: inherit M3 TRAINING_FAILED; normalization error >1e-12 is NUMERICALLY_UNSTABLE
M4.generation: inverse-CDF over sorted enabled glyph/EOS transitions; force EOS at 64 glyphs only if accepting, otherwise NON_GENERATIVE
M4.unseen_scoring: missing topology edge gives probability 0 and HELDOUT_DEGENERATE

M5.components: enumerate all within-TOKEN substrings of length 1..3; support is number of distinct DEVELOPMENT TOKEN types containing the substring; retain support>=min_support; sort by support descending, length descending, code-point ascending; keep first inventory_cap; append every single glyph not retained, in code-point order
M5.segmentation: dynamic programming chooses an exact segmentation with 1..slot_count components minimizing component count, then maximizing left-to-right component lengths lexicographically, then minimizing component strings lexicographically; no overlap; if none, create LEXICAL_EXCEPTION equal to the full TOKEN
M5.rules: a rule is the component-count plus vector of component length classes; retain rules with occurrence support>=min_support, sorted support descending then serialized rule ascending; other segmented TOKENs become STRUCTURAL_EXCEPTIONs
M5.slots: per (rule,slot), inventory contains observed components sorted count descending then code-point ascending, truncated to inventory_cap; a truncated training form becomes LEXICAL_EXCEPTION
M5.estimator: additive alpha=0.5 fixed for rule choice and every slot inventory; exception table uses empirical additive-0.5 choice and is mixed with productive rules by their observed occurrence counts
M5.generation: draw exception-vs-rule, then rule, then each slot component by inverse-CDF; concatenate; reject empty output; stop after one TOKEN
M5.unseen_scoring: sum probabilities of all retained rules producing the form; zero when neither rules nor frozen exception table produces it
M5.complexity: all retained component entries contribute LexiconCost; all exceptions contribute ExceptionCost; rules and probability parameters contribute StructureCost under Task85

calibration.MFC0: iid glyphs uniform over 12; length L=min(12,1+Geometric(p=0.25))
calibration.MFC1: order-2 Markov: initial uniform; P(next=(index+1) mod 12)=0.55, same=0.20, remaining ten each=0.025; EOS hazard 0.20 after glyph 1, forced at 12
calibration.MFC2: six-state PFSA: start 0, accept states 2,4,5; each state has three glyph-labeled edges to (s+1)%6,(s+2)%6,(2s+1)%6 with probabilities 0.50,0.30,0.20 and labels alphabet indices (2s)%12,(2s+1)%12,(2s+2)%12; accepting states choose EOS with probability 0.25 before renormalized edge choice; EOS is forced after glyph 12 from every state
calibration.null_spread: nearest-rank q0.95 of absolute deviations from the sample median over the 16 independent populations; nearest-rank index ceil(0.95*n), one-based; nonfinite inputs invalidate calibration
calibration.threshold_rule: MFC0, MFC1, and MFC2 are applicable to every G1 metric; use the maximum of their generator-specific q0.95 values; no human override

generation.token_count_formula: max(1, round-half-up(scale * compared partition TOKEN count))
generation.convergence: at checkpoint r>=8 compare each metric's median over replicates 0..r-1 with its preceding checkpoint median; converged when abs(delta)<=1e-4+0.01*max(abs(current),abs(previous)) for every applicable metric at all three scales for two consecutive checkpoint comparisons; otherwise run through 32 and mark NON_CONVERGED

metrics.PM1: sum negative log2 observed-unit probability; any zero gives +Inf and HELDOUT_DEGENERATE
metrics.PM2: PM1 divided by scored glyphs including one EOS per TOKEN for M1-M5, and by TOKENs for M0
metrics.PM4: arithmetic mean whole-TOKEN probability over HELDOUT TOKEN occurrences absent as types from DEVELOPMENT
metrics.PM6: occurrence-weighted ROC AUC defined by PM6_DISCRIMINATION_SPEC.md

gates.predictive: PM1,PM2 lower; PM4,PM6 higher; PM5 lower than B1 and applicable B2 by more than the MFC threshold on both transcriptions; PM3 is reporting-only; all five required; direction must agree and relative-effect difference <=0.20 for TRANSCRIPTION_STABLE or is DIRECTION_STABLE otherwise
gates.structural_metric: at matched scale, abs(median_generated-heldout)<=maximum applicable MFC structural-distance threshold
gates.edit_family: at least 3 of its 4 metrics pass
gates.lexical_paradigm_family: at least 2 of its 3 metrics pass
gates.structural_overall: both G1 families pass on both transcriptions and are at least DIRECTION_STABLE
gates.minimality: among candidates passing both gates and no failure, minimize Task85 Complexity separately per transcription; an equivalence set satisfies abs(delta)<=max(1 bit,1e-6*min complexity); prefer lower model rank then candidate_id; both transcriptions must select the same model class
gates.representational_gain: child passes both adequacy gates and has total description length Complexity+PM1 lower than parent by more than the MFC q0.95 improvement threshold on both transcriptions, with no structural-family regression; compare M3 and M4 independently against M2 and the better adequate one against M5
gates.token_formation_depth: selected M0=>FREQUENCY_ONLY; M1=>LOCAL_MARKOV; M2=>VARIABLE_MEMORY; M3 or M4=>FINITE_STATE; M5=>EXPLICIT_RULE_SYSTEM; no adequate candidate, transcription class disagreement, or unsupported required ladder edge=>NOT_IDENTIFIABLE
gates.explicit_rule_required: SUPPORTED iff an M5 candidate passes both gates and every adequate M0-M4 candidate is beaten by M5 under representational_gain; NOT_SUPPORTED iff some M0-M4 candidate passes both gates and no M5 beats it; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE

failure.NUMERICALLY_UNSTABLE: any NaN/Inf other than PM1/PM2 +Inf from an explicit zero, any probability normalization absolute error>1e-12, undefined-score fraction>0, convergence not reached by 32, or replicate CV>0.25 at r=32
failure.COMPLEXITY_UNBOUNDED: at nested sorted-leaf DEVELOPMENT fractions 0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00, Theil-Sen slope of log2 Complexity vs log2 scored units >1.10 and lower endpoint of a deterministic 1000-resample percentile 95% bootstrap CI >1.00
failure.MEMORIZATION_DOMINATED: DEVELOPMENT-to-HELDOUT PM2 gap exceeds the maximum MFC q0.95 gap and Complexity/(N_dev*log2(alphabet_size+2))>=0.90; Complexity includes StructureCost+LexiconCost+ExceptionCost
failure.TRAINING_FAILED: algorithm error, M3/M4 state-cap fixed-point failure, or 100000 merge/induction operations
failure.NON_GENERATIVE: a requested TOKEN cannot terminate within 64 glyphs under the frozen rule
failure.HELDOUT_DEGENERATE: zero probability for any HELDOUT scored occurrence or no strict frozen-threshold improvement over B1
